field.label: Cryptographic Hardware
field.help: A cryptographic accelerator module uses hardware capacity to speed up cryptographic operations like encrypting, decrypting, and hashing.

field.label: Enable PowerD
field.help: The powerd utility monitors the system state and sets the CPU frequency accordingly.

field.label: On AC Power Mode
field.help: CPU frequency mode while on AC power.

field.label: On Battery Power Mode
field.help: CPU frequency mode while on battery power.

field.label: On Normal Power Mode
field.help: CPU frequency mode when power source is unknown.

field.label: Use RAM disk for /var
field.help: Set up a RAM disk for /var. All data will be lost across reboots unless backed up.

field.label: /var RAM Disk Size (%)
field.help: Percentage of total memory to allocate to /var RAM disk (0-100, leave blank for default 50%).

field.label: Use RAM disk for /tmp
field.help: Set up a RAM disk for /tmp. All temporary files will be stored in memory.

field.label: /tmp RAM Disk Size (%)
field.help: Percentage of total memory to allocate to /tmp RAM disk (0-100, leave blank for default 50%).

field.label: Use swap file
field.help: Create and use a swap file in /usr/swap.

field.label: Disable Speaker
field.help: Prevent the system from playing melodies on startup and shutdown through the internal PC speaker.
